'''Azook of Denden''' was a [[Swokes Swokes/Legends|Swokes Swokes]] [[caliph]]. A stash of [[firegem]]s was rumored to lie beneath his memorial [[stela]] in the [[Tract of Makem Te|Tract]] of [[Makem Te/Legends|Makem Te]]. The treasure was well guarded by both the severe conditions in the Tract area and by penitents of the [[Temple of the Beatific Razor]] religious sect, who opposed the desecration of stelae.<ref name="Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref>
